title: TOEIC reading material cards

source.name: toeic-reading-note
source.text: Memo: The sales department will move to the fifth floor on Monday. Employees should pack personal items by Friday afternoon. The IT team will disconnect desktop computers at 6 p.m. Friday and reconnect them before Monday morning. Key phrase: by Friday afternoon means no later than Friday afternoon.

rubric_notes: Include main idea, detail, and paraphrase-style TOEIC reading points.
